messages:
ryan: Noticing a steady rise in nvme write latency on ap-southeast1 since 01:30 UTC, and a coincident uptick in gpu-attach timeouts. provisioner logs show 'attach_io_blocked'.
elaine: Any rolling maintenance or FW pushes?
noah: We rolled preserve-flag pruning and increased janitor.batch_size to 16 at 01:15 for a cleanup throughput experiment.
storage-bot: cron: 'janitor-prune' started cohort ap-se1-* at 01:18 concurrency=16.
ryan: sample iostat from node ap-se1-44:
```
Device       r/s     w/s   rkB/s  wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1      0.5  420.3    1.6 26880    64.0    15.23  55.4  0.15  99.2
```
elaine: avgqu > 15 and %util ~99 suggests queue saturation. do we have any network retries around that time?
noah: logs show objectstore PUT retries spiking x7 around 01:28-01:36 UTC in ap-southeast1. clients doing synchronous fsyncs on retry -> writeback stall.
ryan: so dual stress: high janitor concurrency + objectstore retry storm -> nvme queue full -> gpu attach waits on local disk operations.
elaine: mitigation: 1) roll janitor.batch_size down to 4 for ap-southeast1, 2) pause preserve-flag auto-prune for 30m, 3) set vm.dirty_ratio=6 on hosts, 4) route new gpu requests to ap-northeast1 for 1h.
noah: flipping flag: `curl -XPOST https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"key":"janitor.batch_size","value":"4","scope":"ap-southeast1"}'`
storage-bot: flag-change: "janitor.batch_size" 16 -> 4 by infra-deploy at 01:40 UTC.
ryan: after first 25% hosts patched, attach failures dropped 8.9% -> 1.7% over 5m. great signal.
elaine: followups: 1) revoke current FW cohort until audit, 2) add cross-signal alert when nvme.%util > 85% AND provisioner.attach_errors > 3%, 3) create a staging test that injects objectstore retries while running janitor at scale.
noah: filing STORAGE-503 with timeline, host-list, iostat samples, and proposed kernel tunables.
ryan: created incident INC-2026-114, paging storage, network, and release. please attach core dumps and s3 client trace ids.
oncall-sre: acknowledged, noted mitigation steps. post host list to incident doc and clip the failing attach traces. :eyes:
